articles.abstract_en: We introduce a theory of dominance that encompasses as special cases the theory of admissible decision procedures in statistics, strict and weak dominance among strategies in games, first or second-order stochastic dominance among monetary lotteries, and Pareto dominance among social alternatives. One choice dominates another if in a variety of situations the former choice yields higher expected utility than the latter. We show that under certain assumptions, which include most importantly convexity of the set of situations, and linearity of the decision maker’s utility function in the argument that describes the situation, all undominated choices are optimal in some situation. We show this result for three different definitions of dominance. Our analysis of existing dominance notions in economics in one common framework allows us to compare the properties of these concepts, and to obtain insights into why certain versions of our result apply only to some, but not all of these concepts. We motivate the concept of undominated strategies by developing a formal result relating undominated strategies to rational inattention. As an application that illustrates the general theory we investigate Blackwell dominance among experiments.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们引入了一种支配性理论，该理论涵盖了统计学中可接受决策程序理论、博弈中策略的严格和弱支配性、货币彩票中的一阶或二阶随机支配性以及社会选择中的帕累托支配性作为特例。一种选择支配另一种选择，如果在多种情境下，前者比后者产生更高的期望效用。我们证明，在特定假设下（其中最重要的是情境集合的凸性和决策者效用函数在描述情境的参数上的线性），所有未被支配的选择在某种情境下都是最优的。我们针对三种不同的支配性定义证明了这一结果。我们在一个共同框架下对经济学中现有支配性概念的分析，使我们能够比较这些概念的性质，并深入了解为什么我们结果的某些版本仅适用于部分而非全部这些概念。我们通过发展一个将未支配策略与理性疏忽联系起来的形式化结果来激励未支配策略的概念。作为说明一般理论的应用，我们研究了实验之间的布莱克威尔支配性。

articles.title_en: Nominal rigidities, rational inattention, and the optimal monetary policy
articles.title_cn: 名义刚性、理性疏忽与最优货币政策
articles.abstract_en: Optimal monetary policy has traditionally assigned greater importance to stabilizing prices in sectors with stickier prices, based on multi-sector models assuming full information or exogenous information frictions. This paper challenges the prevailing policy prescription by introducing rational inattention with endogenous information acquisition. Interestingly, the optimal policy assigns a smaller weight to sectors with stickier prices when the cost of information acquisition is sufficiently high. This counterintuitive result arises from the endogenous relationship between firms’ attention and nominal rigidities: firms in sectors with more flexible prices pay less attention to macroeconomic conditions. We provide empirical evidence supporting this mechanism.
articles.abstract_cn: 传统上，最优货币政策在多部门模型中假定完全信息或外生信息摩擦，更重视稳定价格粘性较高部门的物价。本文通过引入内生信息获取的理性疏忽，挑战了这一主流政策处方。有趣的是，当信息获取成本足够高时，最优政策赋予价格粘性较高部门的权重较小。这一反直觉结果源于企业注意力与名义刚性之间的内生关系：价格更灵活部门的企业对宏观经济状况的关注较少。我们提供了支持这一机制的经验证据。

articles.title_en: Random allocations of multiple objects with incomplete information
articles.title_cn: 不完全信息下多物品的随机分配
articles.abstract_en: We propose a condition under which a system of linear inequalities can be found to characterize ex post and interim allocation mechanisms that assign multiple heterogeneous indivisible objects to many agents and also satisfy complex distributional constraints in an incomplete information environment. This condition is called total unimodularity, a well-recognized and rich class of matrices whose entries are −1, 0, or 1. The condition is so general as to extend and unify a number of well-known results, offer new and general results, and cover such as hierarchies, bihierarchies, adjacency, dependence chains, M♮-concavity, 1-substitutes, and paramodularity. We also provide several applications of practical interest.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出一个条件，在该条件下，可以找到一组线性不等式来刻画在不完全信息环境中，将多个异质不可分割物品分配给多个代理人，并同时满足复杂分配约束的事后和中期分配机制。这个条件被称为全幺模性，这是一个公认且丰富的矩阵类别，其元素为−1、0或1。该条件非常普遍，能够扩展并统一多个已知结果，提供新的和一般性的结果，并涵盖诸如层级、双层级、邻接、依赖链、M♮-凹性、1-替代性和参数模性等情形。我们还提供了几个具有实际意义的应用。

articles.title_en: The shocks matter: Labor mobility and the welfare cost of a currency union
articles.title_cn: 冲击的重要性：劳动力流动性与货币联盟的福利成本
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we study the impact of labor mobility on the welfare cost of a currency union in an open economy New Keynesian model. We find that the relationship between labor mobility and exchange rate flexibility depends on the source of asymmetric regional shocks. With demand shocks, labor mobility reduces the welfare cost of a union by reducing the cost of shifting labor to concentrated areas of high demand. With supply shocks, flexible exchange rates can work in conjunction with higher labor mobility to reallocate the factors of production to higher productivity regions of potential currency areas. Therefore, higher labor mobility can widen the welfare gap between fixed and flexible exchange rate regimes, implying areas with high inter-regional labor mobility may benefit more from exchange rate flexibility.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们在一个开放经济新凯恩斯模型中研究了劳动力流动性对货币联盟福利成本的影响。我们发现，劳动力流动性与汇率灵活性之间的关系取决于不对称区域冲击的来源。在需求冲击下，劳动力流动性通过降低将劳动力转移到高需求集中区域的成本，减少了联盟的福利成本。在供给冲击下，灵活的汇率可以与更高的劳动力流动性协同作用，将生产要素重新分配到潜在货币区域中生产率更高的地区。因此，更高的劳动力流动性可以扩大固定汇率制度与浮动汇率制度之间的福利差距，这意味着区域间劳动力流动性高的地区可能从汇率灵活性中获益更多。

articles.title_en: Managing the expectations of buyers with reference-dependent preferences
articles.title_cn: 管理具有参照依赖偏好的买家的预期
articles.abstract_en: I consider a model of monopoly pricing where a firm makes a price offer to a buyer with reference-dependent preferences without being able to commit to it. The reference point is the ex-ante probability of trade and the buyer exhibits an attachment effect: the higher his expectations to buy, the higher his willingness-to-pay. When the buyer’s valuation is private information, a unique equilibrium exists where the firm plays a mixed strategy and its profits are the same as in the reference-independent benchmark. The equilibrium always entails inefficiencies: even as the firm’s information converges to complete information, it mixes on a non-vanishing support and the probability of no trade is greater than zero. Finally, I show that when the firm can design a test about the buyer’s valuation, it can do strictly better than in the reference-independent benchmark by leveraging the uncertainty generated by a noisy test.
articles.abstract_cn: 我考虑一个垄断定价模型，其中企业向具有参照依赖偏好的买家提出价格要约，但无法承诺该要约。参照点是交易的先验概率，买家表现出依恋效应：他购买的预期越高，其支付意愿就越高。当买家的估价是私人信息时，存在一个唯一均衡，其中企业采用混合策略，其利润与参照无关基准相同。该均衡总是包含无效率：即使企业的信息趋近于完全信息，它也在非消失的支持集上混合，且不交易的概率大于零。最后，我表明，当企业可以设计关于买家估价的测试时，它可以通过利用噪声测试产生的不确定性，比参照无关基准做得更好。

articles.title_en: On the core of markets with co-ownerships and indivisibilities
articles.title_cn: 论具有共同所有权和不可分割性的市场核心
articles.abstract_en: Following Balbuzanov and Kotowski (2019), we study the exchange of indivisible objects among agents with unit demand, where initially each object is either privately owned or is co-owned by multiple agents. We propose a new notion of core called the effective core for these problems to address the inadequacies of conventional notions of core. We say that a coalition effectively blocks an assignment if it weakly blocks it—as in the definition of the strong core—and the blocking is credible in the sense that no agent in the coalition takes any redundant object owned by a self-feasible subcoalition. We show that the effective core is a nonempty subset of the weak core and a superset of the strong core, and all assignments in it are Pareto efficient. We also propose a strategy-proof algorithm to find assignments in the effective core. Lastly, we make a detailed comparison between the effective core and Balbuzanov and Kotowski’s exclusion core.
articles.abstract_cn: 继 Balbuzanov 和 Kotowski（2019）之后，我们研究了具有单位需求的代理人之间不可分割的对象的交换，其中最初每个对象要么是私人拥有的，要么是由多个代理人共同拥有的。针对这些问题，我们提出了一种新的核心概念，称为有效核心，以解决传统核心概念的不足。我们说，如果一个联盟弱地阻止了一项分配（如强核心的定义），那么该联盟就有效地阻止了一项分配，并且该阻止是可信的，因为联盟中没有代理会获取自可行子联盟所拥有的任何冗余对象。我们证明有效核心是弱核心的非空子集和强核心的超集，并且其中的所有分配都是帕累托有效的。我们还提出了一种策略证明算法来查找有效核心中的分配。最后，我们对有效核与巴尔布扎诺夫和科托夫斯基的排除核进行了详细的比较。

articles.abstract_en: We study social learning in markets where a monopolistic seller and potential buyers learn from past buyers’ reviews and experiences. Because buyers can wait before purchasing, they have an incentive to free-ride on information from other buyers. The seller has to take this informational externality between buyers into account in her pricing. Our main result is that any Markov perfect equilibrium is inefficient because of too little and too slow sales. This is contrary to the results absent learning. We then show that the seller’s commitment power can alleviate these inefficiencies. In addition, we demonstrate that good news learning causes too little total sales and bad news learning causes too slow sales.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了市场中垄断卖方和潜在买方从过去买方的评论和体验中学习的社会学习过程。由于买方可以等待购买，他们有动机搭其他买方信息的便车。卖方在定价时必须考虑买方之间的这种信息外部性。我们的主要结果是，任何马尔可夫完美均衡都是无效率的，因为销售过少且过慢。这与无学习情况下的结果相反。然后我们表明，卖方的承诺能力可以缓解这些无效率。此外，我们证明，好消息学习导致总销售过少，而坏消息学习导致销售过慢。

articles.title_en: Bank runs and interventions with wholesale funding
articles.title_cn: 银行挤兑与批发融资干预
articles.abstract_en: We study how access to wholesale funding affects bank fragility when policymakers can intervene efficiently during a run. In a Diamond-Dybvig environment with a wholesale market, banks can refinance rather than liquidate assets. We show that the effect of wholesale borrowing on fragility depends both on the cost of funds and on the allocation of seniority among creditors. When wholesale lenders are senior, the availability of funds decreases fragility when borrowing is inexpensive; while when borrowing is costly, greater access to wholesale funding increases fragility because it delays intervention and increases depositors’ incentives to run. In contrast, when depositors are senior, wholesale borrowing always decreases fragility. These findings highlight that seniority allocation is a key determinant of how wholesale funding shapes policy responses and bank fragility. In particular, although recent episodes suggest that wholesale investors typically hold seniority, our findings suggest that granting priority to depositors could make the banking system less fragile.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了当政策制定者能够在挤兑期间进行有效干预时，获得批发融资如何影响银行脆弱性。在具有批发市场的Diamond-Dybvig环境中，银行可以再融资而非清算资产。我们表明，批发借款对脆弱性的影响既取决于资金成本，也取决于债权人之间的优先权分配。当批发贷款人具有优先权时，在借款成本低廉的情况下，资金的可得性降低了脆弱性；而当借款成本高昂时，更大的批发融资获取增加了脆弱性，因为它延迟了干预并增加了存款人的挤兑激励。相反，当存款人具有优先权时，批发借款总是降低脆弱性。这些发现强调了优先权分配是批发融资如何塑造政策反应和银行脆弱性的关键决定因素。特别是，尽管近期事件表明批发投资者通常持有优先权，但我们的发现表明，给予存款人优先权可能使银行体系更不脆弱。

articles.abstract_en: We examine dynamic network formation from a centralized perspective, where a forward-looking social planner constructs one new link between previously unconnected nodes in each period. The planner derives utility from the discounted sum of benefits generated throughout the formation process. Assuming the planner’s instantaneous utility depends monotonically on the aggregate number of walks of various lengths within the network, we derive several key results. First, it is always optimal to form a nested split graph at each stage, regardless of the discount function. Second, when the planner is sufficiently myopic, the optimal strategy uniquely generates a quasi-complete graph in each period. This finding provides a micro-foundation for quasi-complete graphs as natural outcomes of greedy network formation processes. Finally, we extend our analysis to weighted networks, demonstrating the robustness of our results.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们从集中式视角考察动态网络形成，其中一位前瞻性的社会规划者在每个时期在先前未连接的节点之间构建一条新链接。规划者从形成过程中产生的收益的折现总和获得效用。假设规划者的瞬时效用单调依赖于网络内各种长度游走的总数，我们得出了几个关键结果。首先，无论折现函数如何，每个阶段形成嵌套分割图总是最优的。其次，当规划者足够短视时，最优策略在每个时期唯一地生成一个准完全图。这一发现为准完全图作为贪婪网络形成过程的自然结果提供了微观基础。最后，我们将分析扩展到加权网络，证明了我们结果的稳健性。

articles.title_en: Information design for social learning on a recommendation platform
articles.title_cn: 推荐平台上社会学习的信息设计
articles.abstract_en: A recommendation platform sequentially collects information about a new product revealed from past consumer trials, and uses it to better guide later consumers. Because consumers do not internalize the value of information they bring to others, their incentive for trying out the product can be socially insufficient. Given such a challenge, I study how the platform can improve social welfare by designing its recommendation policy. In a model with binary product quality and general trial-generated signals, I find that the optimal design features a U-shaped sequence of recommendation standards over the product’s life, and the optimal learning dynamic can involve temporary suspensions following negative consumer feedback when the product is young. Comparative statics and extensions explore how the optimal design adjusts under changes in trial informativeness, consumer arrival rates, and platform bias. My analysis also illustrates the usefulness of a Lagrangian duality approach for dynamic information design.
articles.abstract_cn: 推荐平台依次收集过去消费者试用中揭示的新产品信息，并利用这些信息更好地指导后续消费者。由于消费者不内化他们为他人带来的信息价值，他们尝试产品的激励可能在社会上是不足的。面对这一挑战，我研究了平台如何通过设计其推荐政策来改善社会福利。在一个具有二元产品质量和一般试用生成信号的模型中，我发现最优设计在产品生命周期中呈现出推荐标准的U形序列，并且最优学习动态可能涉及在产品年轻时期负面消费者反馈后的暂时暂停。比较静态分析和扩展探讨了在试用信息量、消费者到达率和平台偏差变化时最优设计的调整。我的分析还说明了拉格朗日对偶方法在动态信息设计中的实用性。

articles.title_en: Preferences for the resolution of risk and ambiguity
articles.title_cn: 风险与模糊性解决偏好
articles.abstract_en: Generalized recursive utility models often imply that agents have a preference over the timing of uncertainty resolution. Laboratory elicitations of subjects’ preferences generally provide direct evidence in support of this implication, but only in the domain of risk. We provide the first experimental examination of uncertainty resolution with respect to ambiguity, in addition to risk. The modal subject exhibits a preference for both early resolution of risk and ambiguity, but with only a minimal willingness to pay to realize either over late resolution. While preferences in both domains are positively correlated, the strength of that correlation varies based on ambiguity attitudes. Among ten commonly used representative recursive utility models, we identify the models that most efficiently explain observed subject preferences under two alternative assumptions: treating a subject’s token willingness to pay as either a true preference or indifference.
articles.abstract_cn: 广义递归效用模型通常意味着经济主体对不确定性解决的时间安排有偏好。实验室对受试者偏好的诱导通常直接支持这一含义，但仅限于风险领域。我们首次在风险之外，对模糊性相关的不确定性解决进行了实验检验。模态受试者表现出对风险和模糊性早期解决的偏好，但仅为实现任一早期解决而愿意支付的金额极小。虽然两个领域的偏好呈正相关，但相关强度因模糊态度而异。在十种常用的代表性递归效用模型中，我们识别出在两种替代假设下最能有效解释观察到的受试者偏好的模型：将受试者的代币支付意愿视为真实偏好或视为无差异。

articles.title_en: When speed is of essence: perishable goods auctions
articles.title_cn: 当速度至关重要：易腐商品拍卖
articles.abstract_en: We study a remarkable auction used in several fish markets around the world, notably in Honolulu and Sydney, whereby high-quality fish are sold fast through a hybrid auction that combines the Dutch and the English formats in one auction. Speedy sales are of essence for these perishable goods. Our theoretical model incorporating “time costs” demonstrates that such Honolulu-Sydney auction is preferred by the auctioneer over the Dutch auction when there are few bidders or when bidders have high time costs. Our laboratory experiments confirm that with a small number of bidders, Honolulu-Sydney auctions are significantly faster than Dutch auctions. Bidders overbid in Dutch, benefiting the auctioneer, while the Honolulu-Sydney format benefits bidders more compared to Dutch across all treatments. We further observe bidder attempts to tacitly lower prices in Honolulu-Sydney auctions, substantiating existing concerns about pricing in some fish markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一种在世界多个鱼市场（尤其是檀香山和悉尼）使用的显著拍卖方式，其中高品质鱼类通过结合荷兰式和英式拍卖格式的混合拍卖快速售出。对于这些易腐商品，快速销售至关重要。我们的理论模型纳入“时间成本”，表明当竞拍者数量少或竞拍者时间成本高时，拍卖者更偏好这种檀香山-悉尼拍卖而非荷兰式拍卖。我们的实验室实验证实，在竞拍者数量少的情况下，檀香山-悉尼拍卖显著快于荷兰式拍卖。竞拍者在荷兰式拍卖中出价过高，有利于拍卖者，而檀香山-悉尼格式在所有处理中相比荷兰式拍卖更有利于竞拍者。我们进一步观察到竞拍者试图在檀香山-悉尼拍卖中默契压低价格，这证实了关于某些鱼市场定价的现有担忧。
